_readme: TMP_009 iteration 14 — ControlNet base-plate structural intervention. After 13 iterations confirmed the LANGUAGE CEILING (iter 13 sub-agent: 'Ceiling hit; needs structural intervention'), this iteration adds xinsir-union-promax canny ControlNet keyed to a centred dome silhouette hint image. Model is spatially constrained to render foliage inside the dome and suppress everything outside. Iter 6 prompt verbatim + zero LoRA + same fixture. New alias `realisticfantasy-controlnet-canny` routes the same `terrain-realisticfantasy-v30` checkpoint through `workflows/sdxl_eps_canny_union.json` (with ControlNet nodes). Hint: `experiments/tmp_009/hint_dome_canny_1024.png` (1024x1024 black canvas + centred 720x520 white ellipse outline, ~2px). ControlNet strength=0.7, start=0.0, end=0.5 (lock composition early, free late-step detail). Hypothesis: structural enforcement bypasses the prompt-prior ceiling that 13 language iterations could not break.
